messages:
elena: noticed post-deploy smoke failing for embed-route in eu-west-3; synth shows 429s and p95 doubled. @kai can you check?

kai: which deployment? grabbing logs.

elena: release=embed-route-7.0.0, region=eu-west-3, canary=10%. repro curl: ```curl -sS -X POST https://euw3.embed.redwood/smoke -H 'Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE' -d '{"text":"hello"}' -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n"``` -> HTTP:429 body: {"error":"rate_limited"}

synth-bot: synthetic alert: scenario "embed-basic" returned 429 rate 60% starting ~30s after rollout.

deploy-bot: rollout event: embed-route-7.0.0 -> eu-west-3 (canary=10%) at 3959989950. initial probes green.

kai: checking edge and rate-limiter logs... seeing sudden spike in local rate-limiter rejects for the new variant; config flag `per_worker_limit` default changed in 7.0.0 (15->3) causing effective global burst limit drop when workers scale. new warmstarts increase concurrency and quickly hit low per-worker limit -> 429s.

elena: ugh. prefer to pin region to previous stable (6.12.4) while we revert the default or patch the limiter. pin vs rollback?

kai: pin recommended. plan: pause further canary growth, route eu-west-3 to 6.12.4, and add a temporary config override to set per_worker_limit=15 until fix rolled. also add a smoke-runner retry backoff to reduce alert noise.

ops-bot: incident INC-9209 created: "embed-route 429s eu-west-3" assigned to kai, elena.

kai: applying route pin to embed-route-6.12.4 for eu-west-3 now. ETA ~90s.

elena: updating release notes: "paused embed-route-7.0.0 eu-west-3 canary due to aggressive per-worker rate-limit defaults causing synthetic 429s; pinned to 6.12.4 pending hotfix." adding brief rollback checklist note.

deploy-bot: route pin applied: eu-west-3 -> embed-route-6.12.4. smoke probes back to green.

kai: will open a hotfix PR to restore per_worker_limit default and add a startup check that warns on low limits. will also run local repro with staggered warmstart to validate.

elena: hold on global rollback. keep pin in place until PR merges and smoke-runner validates. please post a short postmortem blurb and repro steps in this thread once done. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: runbook reminder: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/release-pins

kai: leaving thread open for handoff; ETA for repro logs ~30m.

elena: thanks team, cc'ing product and support for visibility.
